entities.name: ACC carboxyltransferase
observations: Sequence is 587 aa; Swiss-Prot homologs are ACC carboxyltransferase subunits beta/alpha, with 52.6–58.1% identity and near-full coverage.
Pfam hits include Zn_ribbon_ACC (PF17848), Carboxyl_trans (PF01039), and ACCA (PF03255).
Homology-based annotation assigns EC 2.1.3.15 and Zn2+ binding; direct experimental validation of this query sequence is not established.

entities.name: ACC carboxyl transfer
observations: N(6)-carboxybiotinyl-L-lysyl-[protein] + acetyl-CoA = N(6)-biotinyl-L-lysyl-[protein] + malonyl-CoA; Rhea RHEA:10505/RHEA:54728; EC 2.1.3.15.
